description_en: Queries the kubeconfig file of a Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster in which an RDS Custom instance resides
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-rc-cluster-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpc-id None --temporary-duration-minutes 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRCClusterConfig

parameters.help_en:
The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID.

This is a reserved parameter
parameters.help_zh:
专有网络VPC的ID。

预留参数
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the temporary kubeconfig file. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 15 to 4320.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system specifies a longer validity period. The validity period is returned in the `expiration` parameter
parameters.help_zh:
临时kubeconfig有效期，单位：分钟。取值范围：15（15分钟）～4320（3天）。
当不设置该参数时，将由系统自动确定一个更长的有效期，具体过期时间通过返回的`expiration`字段的值确定
parameters.name: temporary_duration_minutes

Config.description_en: The kubeconfig file of the cluster

Expiration.description_en: The expiration time of the kubeconfig file. Format: the UTC time in the RFC3339 format
Expiration.description_zh: KubeConfig 的过期时间。格式：RFC3339格式的UTC时间
